name: Theme Songs
description:
Downloads theme songs for your TV series and saves them as theme.mp3 inside each series folder, which is where Jellyfin's built-in "Play Theme Songs" feature looks. A nightly scheduled task sweeps the library, and it can optionally fetch a theme as soon as a new series is added.

Requirements: Jellyfin 10.11 or later, and the server process must have write access to your TV library folders — that is where the files are created. Themes come from tvthemes.plexapp.com, a free third-party service with no SLA that covers TV series only and has gaps for very recent shows.

It never overwrites an existing theme.mp3, validates every download is a real MP3 before writing it, writes atomically so an interrupted download cannot leave a corrupt file, and remembers failures so it does not re-request a missing theme every night. Series with no TVDB ID are skipped silently.
overview: Automatically downloads TV theme songs so Jellyfin can play them on series pages.
